name: Custodial
summary: Exchange / hosted wallet: max convenience & support recovery; accept counterparty, phishing, seizure, and insolvency risk. Harden with hardware 2FA, allowlists, and limited balances.

name: Single-sig hot wallet
summary: Phone/desktop wallet you control: convenient spending and better privacy than KYC exchanges, but malware and seed handling dominate risk.

name: Single-sig cold wallet
summary: Hardware or air-gapped single signature: strong malware resistance when used correctly; supply-chain, entropy, and backup discipline matter. Still one seed to rule them all.

name: Multisig (distributed / multi-party)
summary: m-of-n with diverse vendors and locations/parties: removes single points of failure; higher complexity; watch for same-vendor correlation and key-agent custody risk.
